all_rows.definition: keys (inchikey, property, T_K) with more than one distinct value

conflicts.no_averaging: conflicting values at the same (inchikey, property, T_K) are all kept; they are never averaged, and the conflict count is reported per key

publishable_core_only.definition: keys (inchikey, property, T_K) with more than one distinct value

deviations_and_uncertainties.detail: merge_rules.first_build_sources describes the PubChem liquid-window harvest as 'MP/BP/FP/density, filter_only', but observation_schema restricts property to epsilon and viscosity. MP/BP/FP/density are neither, so they are enumerated in the exclusions file (reason property_not_in_joint_enum) instead of being stored. Storing them would require editing the locked schema, which lock_rule forbids; this is reported as a correction candidate for a later round.

two harvested Dielectric Constant strings fit the property enum but state no frequency, and the schema note says a dielectric value without its frequency is not a defined measurement; both are excluded (reason dielectric_frequency_unstated) rather than stored with an empty frequency.

every epsilon row carries uncertainty_kind='combined' from the source, while the schema note lists 'expanded / standard / unknown'. The source value is kept verbatim rather than reinterpreted; this needs a main-thread decision.

no harvested PubChem viscosity value row carries an ExtendedReference DOI, so source_doi is empty on every filter_only row. The schema allows an empty DOI only in filter_only, which is exactly this layer.

the harvest stores viscosity as free text. Only shapes with one number, one recognised unit and one numeric temperature are read; every other clause leaves an exclusion record. A different parser would yield a different count, so those rows stay filter_only and are never quoted in the publishable headline.

data/viscosity_v01.csv carries no composition column. It is the open subset of a one-InChIKey-per-row pure-substance viscosity supplement, so n_components=1 and pure_or_mixture='pure' are recorded and not silently defaulted.

viscosity_observations_thermoml.csv exposes 'smiles_or_name', which holds the compound name on every row inspected; smiles is therefore empty on every ThermoML viscosity row rather than guessed from a name.

the schema prescribes row_id={dataset_id}:{source_row_index}, so a harvested PubChem value row that reports two temperatures yields two rows with the same row_id. Uniqueness is carried by the primary key, which has no duplicates.
this build reads the locked prereg and never writes it; the schema was not back-filled and no frozen artefact was modified.

evaluation_contract.assertion: group_overlap == 0 between train and test groups

random_row.role: leak reference only; it never enters a verdict

evaluation_contract.verdict_derived_this_round: none: this round is data engineering, no model is fitted

exclusions.definition: a row excluded from the table is written to an exclusions file with the reason; a shrinking row count without an exclusion record is a defect

chew_2024_supp_3_predicted.note: predicted values are not observations; the file is not opened by this builder

mixture_rows.note: stored, but the modelled target is the pure-substance subset

reaxys_values.note: restricted_crosscheck_only; no Reaxys row has a code path into the table

schrodinger_restricted_858.note: the builder opens only data/viscosity_v01.csv; there is no fetch, inference or reconstruction code path for the 858 withheld values

filter_only_layer.definition: compilation-level values (PubChem depositor aggregates, safety sheets). Allowed into the table with quality_layer=filter_only so the funnel can use them, never quoted as a core value and never counted in the publishable headline.

integrity.row_id_note: row_id is the schema-prescribed {dataset_id}:{source_row_index} label, so a source row that yields several measurements shares it; uniqueness is carried by the primary key (inchikey, property, T_K, source_file, source_row_index)

observation_schema.unit_rule: epsilon is dimensionless and stored as unit='1'; viscosity is stored in Pa*s and the cP copy the sources carry is NOT a second column here, it is recomputed by anyone who wants it

pubchem_records_without_properties.note: a 404 harvest entry carries no value row at all, so there is no row to exclude

publishable_headline.definition: quality_layer=publishable_core, i.e. first-hand DOI plus a measurement
